scope: Semantic asset families in current procedural source. Family records are not counts of mesh parts or placed instances. Catalog-only assets are enumerated by propCollection.

entries.name: Cypress bench and green litter bin
entries.notes: Shared model source; world placement, collisions and batch remain scene-owned.

entries.name: Café chairs, round tables and parasols
entries.notes: Shared source; four table arrangements and pink parasol variation remain scene-owned.

entries.name: Backed/backless trail benches, concrete bins, bicycle racks, interpretation boards
entries.notes: Distinct designs from the cypress bench. Extract raw builders before catalog registration; preserve OSM seats, authored infill and shared batching.

entries.name: Jewell benches, litter/recycling containers and lantern
entries.notes: Bench is a distinct design; boxes used as bin proxies are not finished product models.

entries.name: Caledonia benches, picnic tables, basketball hoops and city-photo playground equipment
entries.notes: Keep two court hoops and playground compositions distinct from their court surfaces. Extract and budget before registering.

entries.name: Opening pool gate
entries.notes: Already one batched rigid object. Separate the model from scene collision/toggle logic before exposing an inspection factory.

entries.name: Volleyball posts/net, pool basin/deck/coping and court markings
entries.notes: Net assembly is a reusable candidate; mapped pool/court ground is a location surface.

entries.name: Picket fences, parking bollards/rails and pavement arrows
entries.notes: Parametric fence/rail candidates; terrain-following placement and paint remain site-specific.

entries.name: Chain-link court fences, gates, retaining boundaries and trail rails
entries.notes: Several fence designs; do not merge them into a single invented generic asset.

entries.name: Beach House, Grill and park building details
entries.notes: Mapped shells, roofs, awnings and windows; location study rather than stand-alone interchangeable furniture.

entries.name: Gazebo and Little House
entries.notes: Candidate landmark factories; illustrative dimensions and supported terrain foundations.

entries.name: Meals on Wheels / Sally Griffin frontage and residential massing
entries.notes: Site-specific frontage and contextual buildings, not verified complete architectural models.

entries.name: Waterfront and neighbourhood shells, windows, signs and roofs
entries.notes: Mapped massing and facade components; category recorded without claiming individual complete buildings.

entries.name: Natural History Museum, whale sculpture, planters, rails and stairs
entries.notes: Museum is inspectable in Map Study. Attached detail remains part of that location, not an Objects entry.

entries.name: Aquarium exterior, interior rooms, exhibits and building components
entries.notes: Area/Map inspection; audit individual fixture reuse separately from the full building.

entries.name: Park rocks, low plants and scene-specific trees
entries.notes: Seven tree species are already cataloged. These extra rock/shrub/proxy tree geometries are not the same library models.

entries.name: Reef boulders and attached habitat colonies
entries.notes: Rocks remain scene-only; kelp, stars, urchins and both anemones have library representatives. Colony instances are composition variants.

entries.name: Coastal kelp patches and holdfast rocks
entries.notes: Library kelp with local batching/placement and simplified rock bases.

entries.name: Gym butterflies, gulls, deer, fish, turtles, jellyfish and whales
entries.notes: Land animals are in Objects; fish/turtle/jelly/octopus/whale are in Tank. Schools, herd/pod behavior and routes are scene compositions, not missing species assets.

entries.name: Rods, tackle box, boats, dock, dive rack, Otter Man and two statues
entries.notes: Already cataloged. Oars, boat benches, scuba pieces and suit jets are components of their owning assets.

entries.name: Concrete pier, beach stairs, platforms, seawalls and rails
entries.notes: Location-scale terrain/access assemblies; maintain geometry/collision agreement when extracting reusable sections.

entries.name: Tank gallery enclosure and visitor silhouettes
entries.notes: Visible in Tank. Visitors are separate from configurable avatars; neither belongs to the prop selector by default.

entries.name: Garden benches, drinking fountain, interpretation panels, fossil pit and seasonal wheel
entries.notes: Existing garden props; provisional site designs. The whale sculpture is part of the same garden module.

entries.name: Rod holder, submerged pilings and coastal grass
entries.notes: Small attached/supporting components, currently batched into the harbor.

entries.name: Museum cases, microscope, classroom tables/stools and dioramas
entries.notes: Retained source, not imported by the current museum factory. Do not restore exhibits as part of catalog maintenance.
Photo-derived green four-wheel surrey. Six animated batches; Gym owns kinematic vehicle control and collision; provisional physical dimensions.
